title: Pure-tensor signed Leibniz identity for three external Cech bidegrees
statement: Let k be a field, f:X→Spec k and g:Y→Spec k, U:I→Opens(X) and V:J→Opens(Y) arbitrary families, and F,G modules. Use the scalar Cech complexes [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models] A=C_U(F), B=C_V(G), C=C_W(pr₁*F tensor pr₂*G) of [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models], with W_(i,j)=pr₁⁻¹U_i intersect pr₂⁻¹V_j. Fix p,q in ℕ and three k-linear maps h:A^p tensor_k B^q→C^(p+q), h₁:A^(p+1) tensor_k B^q→C^(p+1+q), h₂:A^p tensor_k B^(q+1)→C^(p+q+1). Suppose each has its prescribed front/back coordinates [lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-bidegree]. For a∈A^p and b∈B^q, d_C(h(a tensor b))=transport(h₁(d_A(a) tensor b))+(-1)^p transport(h₂(a tensor d_B(b))), where the transports identify (p+1)+q and p+(q+1) with (p+q)+1. No map in any other bidegree, total complex, covering or finiteness hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Use [lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-transport] for the three adjacent bidegrees, choosing the unique refinement cochain maps along the two projections. The transport identifies each pure-tensor value with the ordinary cup of the refined factor cochains; its scalar comparison commutes with differentials and equal-degree casts.

Apply the ordinary Cech cup Leibniz identity [def-sc-cech-cup-product] to the refined factor cochains. The refinement cochain-map equations identify the refined differentials with the refinements of the original differentials, and the transported equal-degree casts give the displayed signs and additions. This proves the pure-tensor equality.

theorem picardExternalCechCupBidegree_leibniz
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    (p q : ℕ)
    (h : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + q))
    (h₁ : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X (p + 1))).obj (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X ((p + 1) + q))
    (h₂ : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X (q + 1)) ⟶
      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + (q + 1)))
    (hh : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p q h)
    (hh₁ : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G (p + 1) q h₁)
    (hh₂ : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p (q + 1) h₂)
    (a : ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)
    (b : ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) :
    ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).d
        (p + q) (p + q + 1) (h (a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) =
      (eqToHom (congrArg (fun n ↦
        ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X n)
        (Nat.add_right_comm p 1 q))) 
          (h₁ (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).d p (p + 1) a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) +
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ p • (eqToHom (congrArg (fun n ↦
        ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X n)
        (Nat.add_assoc p q 1).symm))
          (h₂ (a ⊗ₜ[k] ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).d q (q + 1) b))
